target: Teach another learner to reason about memory provenance using a source-linked memory record. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.

competency.title: Teach memory provenance — field data
competency.outcome: Teach another learner to reason about memory provenance using a source-linked memory record. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.
competency.practice_task: Produce a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test grounded in a source-linked memory record.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.
required_evidence: a lesson, coached exercise and blind learner transfer test
Include the data card, missingness check and permitted use.
Report traceable claims and revocation completeness with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: orphaned facts after source deletion.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of memory provenance.
Practice: the learner succeeds on a new case without the answer key.
Measurement: report traceable claims and revocation completeness against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for orphaned facts after source deletion; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
